title: Code and derived data for Unexpectedly low marine heatwave forecast skill during the 2023-2024 El Niño
description: November 2026 snapshot for the current manuscript, in releases/20261112. Includes four main figures, 17 supplementary figures, derived fields and tables, original calculation code, portable plotting code, software versions and checksum/visual validation. Four main figures and 16 supplementary figures were re-rendered with zero pixel differences against the retained final artwork; Supplementary Fig. 7 is retained unchanged. Large third-party forecast and reanalysis archives are not redistributed. Full raw-field recalculation requires provider inputs and path configuration. The archived SST initialization-selection limitation remains documented, and Fig. 4 allocations are statistical rather than causal. Older repository-root products and their contributor credits remain historical and should not be combined with this snapshot.
